purpose: Numerical feasibility of an idealized tet10 problem near the rejected Case4 mesh algebraic size; no patient, tissue-property, injury, or clinical validation.

runtime.runtime_source_binding_policy: Separate root release must pin exact committed benchmark source/decks and reverify profile, runtime identity, executable, linkage, patch and tet10 controls before and after each supervised call. No fallback backend.

mesh.recipe: Structured n-by-n-by-n cubes; each split into the same six tetrahedra along local 0-to-6 body diagonal as the pinned one-cube tet10 control. Straight reference mid-edge nodes shared by integer half-grid identity; FEBio TET10G8 elastic-solid.
mesh.acceptance: Actual generated incidence, positive reference Jacobians at all eight integration points and additional nodes/edge midpoints/centroids, conforming shared midnodes, and boundary tags must be checked before any solve. Expected counts are predictions, not observations.

numerical_gauge.material: Uncoupled Ogden c1=2*mu, m1=2, c2..c6=0, pressure_model=1; numerical gauge only
numerical_gauge.solver: FEBio solid, symmetric stiffness, BFGS; dtol=etol=rtol=1e-10, min_residual=1e-20, max_refs=20, no time-step retries

affine.boundary: Prescribe u=(F-I)X on all six exterior faces; leave all interior nodes free. Compare displacement, stress, J, energy, reaction virtual work with independent analytic homogeneous solution.

nonuniform.reaction_quantity: Net bottom and top reaction vectors in N, independently summed from signed FEBio nodal reactions.

checks.solver_residual: Actual reported final norms must satisfy frozen FEBio tolerances on each completed step; missing or ambiguous residual evidence is inconclusive, not pass.

stop_rule: Stop after first geometry, numerical, backend, hash, wall, RSS or output-cap failure; preserve logs and unattempted statuses. No outcome-based mesh/cap/tolerance change in v1.
admission: Success is idealized solver feasibility only. It cannot admit rejected Case4 geometry, patient material/force estimates, displacement fidelity, clinical use or RL rewards.
